findings.finding: BRAND_ASSET_FILE_RE allows arbitrary [a-z0-9]+[-_]? prefixes (e.g. user-logo.png), contradicting documented '封闭词表' (site/web/app/default/placeholder/official). False positives filter legitimate avatars.
findings.suggestion: Remove unrestricted second prefix; restrict regex to optional first group or empty, aligning with documented vocabulary.

findings.finding: .ccg/reviews JSON references sha 9adf66fd... but proposal head is 6a6e95a...; line counts differ (1361 vs 2177). Review artifact is stale/inconsistent with target.
findings.suggestion: Regenerate .ccg/reviews from actual head commit; reconcile changedLines/fileCount with diff --numstat.

findings.finding: parseWechatMpIdentity relies on regex over HTML. Fragile to whitespace/template changes; no format validation of extracted uid/nickname before return.
findings.suggestion: Add strict format checks (uid numeric, nickname non-empty) and return empty object on mismatch; document HTML dependency.

findings.finding: New 247-line PRD file (01-docs/...) added to diff but untracked by build/tests. Increases repo size without linkage; risk of doc drift.
findings.suggestion: Move PRD to docs/review or verify build tracking; delete if redundant with record file.

findings.finding: finalizeCollectedInfo deletes avatarCandidates in-place via mutation. Calling twice on same raw object yields different results (empty candidates on second pass).
findings.suggestion: Create shallow copy before delete: const out = { ...raw }; delete out.avatarCandidates.

findings.finding: Structure lock depends on parseItBlocks parser. A parser syntax change could make it return zero blocks, causing assertions to pass silently with no coverage.
findings.suggestion: Add parser sanity assertion before loop: expect(parseItBlocks(...).length).toBeGreaterThan(...).

findings.finding: fetchAccountInfoViaHttpApi runs per-source URLs sequentially with 8s individual timeouts. Multi-source platforms (toutiao, xiaohongshu, bilibili) accumulate latency linearly.
findings.suggestion: Run independent source fetches concurrently with Promise.all; merge results, keeping overall timeout.

findings.finding: isBrandImageUrl catches new URL() errors silently; relative URLs (e.g. /logo.png) never filtered (false negative). Documentation and regex behavior diverge.
findings.suggestion: Document absolute-URL-only evaluation; resolve relative paths against Referer if brand paths are relative.
